      paths => {
        const player = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.playerPath, "utf8"));
        const observer = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.observerPath, "utf8"));
        observer.seat.contextDigest = player.seat.contextDigest;
        writeJson(paths.observerPath, observer);
        const adjudicator = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.adjudicatorPath, "utf8"));
        adjudicator.observerPacketSha256 = sha(paths.observerPath);
        writeJson(paths.adjudicatorPath, adjudicator);
      },
      paths => {
        const player = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.playerPath, "utf8"));
        player.sourceIsolation.sourceAccess = "candidate-source";
        writeJson(paths.playerPath, player);
        const observer = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.observerPath, "utf8"));
        observer.playerPacketSha256 = sha(paths.playerPath);
        writeJson(paths.observerPath, observer);
        const adjudicator = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.adjudicatorPath, "utf8"));
        adjudicator.observerPacketSha256 = sha(paths.observerPath);
        writeJson(paths.adjudicatorPath, adjudicator);
      },
      paths => {
        const adjudicator = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.adjudicatorPath, "utf8"));
        adjudicator.seat.seatId = "unity-runtime";
        adjudicator.artifactMutationCapability = true;
        writeJson(paths.adjudicatorPath, adjudicator);
      },
      paths => {
        const observer = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.observerPath, "utf8"));
        const adjudicator = JSON.parse(readFileSync(paths.adjudicatorPath, "utf8"));
        adjudicator.seat.seatId = observer.seat.seatId;
        writeJson(paths.adjudicatorPath, adjudicator);
      },
    ];
    for (const mutate of cases) {
      const paths = fixture();
      mutate(paths);
      const result = spawnSync(ps, [
        "-NoProfile", "-File", script,
        "-PlayerProductTrainReceipt", paths.trainPath,
        "-PlayerSessionReceipt", paths.sessionPath,
        "-PlayerSeatPacket", paths.playerPath,
        "-ObserverSeatPacket", paths.observerPath,
        "-AdjudicatorSeatPacket", paths.adjudicatorPath,
      ], { cwd: ROOT, encoding: "utf8" });
      expect(result.status).not.toBe(0);
    }
  });
});
